description: This file contains implementations of fused Adam and AMSGrad optimizer kernels optimized for MPS (Metal Performance Shaders) in PyTorch, specifically defining functions for applying fused Adam/AMSGrad updates on tensors with support for optional parameters and specialized kernel name generation.

methods.name: _fused_adam_amsgrad_mps_impl_
methods.description: Implements a fused Adam and AMSGrad optimizer update for MPS using tensor lists and applies the update via multi_tensor_apply_for_fused_optimizer with specified hyperparameters.

methods.name: _fused_adam_amsgrad_mps_impl_
methods.description: Overloaded version accepting Tensor references for learning rate and other hyperparameters, performing similar fused optimizer update with kernel name generation based on tensor types.
